semantics.mode: authoritative: for a covered symbol every product event is suppressed and the chain is built from the pack's replace_step rows
semantics.replace_step: suppress every product event on effective_date and insert one step with ratio; ratio is the reference-implied step
semantics.suppress_step: suppress every product event on effective_date
semantics.raw_ohlc: per-field historical display value from the frozen reference type0 bar; never rewrites corporate events

usage: Derived factor segments and sparse per-field values only; no bulk raw series redistribution.
